stem.text: The graphs show trends in four physical properties of elements in Period 3, excluding argon.
Which graph has electronegativity on the $y$-axis?

A.alt: Line graph with markers at Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl: rises to a sharp peak at Si, then falls at P and stays low.

B.alt: Line graph with markers at Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl: falls steeply from Na, then levels off towards Cl.

C.alt: Line graph with markers at Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl: zig-zag rising trend with small dips at Al and S.

D.alt: Line graph with markers at Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl: nearly straight steady rise from Na to Cl.
